verdict.rationale: First-party docs state you can "get web-grounded answers with built-in citations in one call" and direct developers to the Agent API for an LLM-generated answer with citations. The Sonar API reference response schema includes `citations` and `search_results` fields, confirming sourced answers are returned in a single request. The community comment notes Sonar models have long been available via API, which is consistent with this. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of answer/citation quality.
